summary: Nền tảng backend Ontology-driven của OpenBKN, chuyển đổi ngữ nghĩa kinh doanh thành runtime services với dữ liệu, logic, hành vi, bảo mật và khả quan quan sát.
usecases: Generating runtime services from ontology models for enterprise applications.
Providing semantic security governance and observability for context-aware microservices.
Enabling automated data logic generation from knowledge graphs.
ideas: Combining with LLM agents for semantic reasoning over enterprise data.
Deploying as a decentralized ontology layer for Web3 semantic networks.
Exposing as a universal API gateway for ontology-driven application development.
